lords.drawback.sloth.1: What it takes: every art and every blow of the axe adds Weight to you (an art 12 to 22, the Lord's decree 45, a plain hit 1). The axe drags the world down with its wielder.
lords.drawback.sloth.2: What it does: from 50 Weight you are Strained and walk slower. At 100 you are Overloaded for 6 seconds: the axe refuses its arts, you walk much slower and dig slower. It never touches your hunger bar and never damages you.
lords.drawback.sloth.3: How it recovers: Weight drains by itself, 1.5 a second (three times as fast while the axe is stowed). A kill with the axe lifts 8. The bar at the bottom left shows it.
lords.drawback.sloth.4: How to handle it: spend arts one at a time and let the bar fall below 50. Mastery of Stillness grows while you are Strained: each level adds 4% less Weight and 5% faster recovery.
lords.drawback.envy.1: What it takes: every art and every blow of the gunblade adds Hollowness to you (an art 12 to 22, the Lord's decree 45, a plain hit 1). The more you covet, the less of you is left.
lords.drawback.envy.2: What it does: from 50 you are Strained and lose 4 maximum health (2 hearts). At 100 you are Overloaded for 6 seconds: you lose 8 (4 hearts), are Weak, and the gunblade refuses its arts. Your hunger bar is never touched.
lords.drawback.envy.3: How it recovers: the Hollowness drains by itself, 1.5 a second (three times as fast while the gunblade is stowed). A kill with the gunblade lifts 8. Lost health returns the moment the Hollowness falls below 50.
lords.drawback.envy.4: How to handle it: fire in bursts and rest between them. Mastery of Covetousness grows while you are Strained: each level adds 4% less Hollowness and 5% faster recovery.
lords.drawback.vanity.1: What it takes: every art and every blow of the spear cracks the mirror a little more (an art 12 to 22, the Lord's decree 45, a plain hit 1). The spear wants to be seen.
lords.drawback.vanity.2: What it does: from 50 you are Strained and shine: you glow, so everyone can see you through walls. At 100 you are Overloaded for 6 seconds: you glow, are Weak, and the spear refuses its arts. It never touches your hunger bar.
lords.drawback.vanity.3: How it recovers: the cracks mend by themselves, 1.5 a second (three times as fast while the spear is stowed). A kill with the spear lifts 8.
lords.drawback.vanity.4: How to handle it: strike from cover, then put the spear away to hide the glow. Mastery of Reflection grows while you are Strained: each level adds 4% less cracking and 5% faster recovery.
lords.drawback.holy.1: What it takes: every art and every blow of Seifort adds Penance to you (an art 12 to 22, the Lord's decree 45, a plain hit 1). Light is not free. Smiting the undead halves what an art costs.
lords.drawback.holy.2: What it does: from 50 you are Strained and every healing you receive is halved. At 100 you are Overloaded for 6 seconds: you are Weak and the sword refuses its arts. It never touches your hunger bar.
lords.drawback.holy.3: How it recovers: Penance drains by itself, 1.5 a second (three times as fast while the sword is stowed). A kill lifts 8, and 16 when the victim was undead.
lords.drawback.holy.4: How to handle it: hunt the undead, heal before you strain, and do not stack arts. Mastery of Devotion grows while you are Strained: each level adds 4% less Penance and 5% faster recovery.
lords.drawback.greed.1: What it takes: the Black Sword drinks what you kill and hungers for more. Its satiation (the red bar at the bottom left) falls over time and with every Secret Technique. It never hurts you and never touches your food bar.
lords.drawback.greed.2: What it does: below 20 satiation the blade is Ravenous: it drinks 1.5% of your current magicule every second, you receive only half of any healing, and only 70% of the devoured bonuses work. At 0 it is Dormant and the devoured bonuses sleep until it is fed.
lords.drawback.greed.3: How it recovers: kill to feed it, or use the Offer mode of the skill (a tenth of your magicule for satiation). Nothing else changes it.
lords.drawback.greed.4: How to handle it: keep the satiation above 20, and hunt before you rest. A Ravenous blade can always be fed back to full by killing.
lords.drawback.greed.5: Half-Starvation (a mode of the skill): you devour twice as much and your stats rise by half, but the blade grows hungry 2.5 times as fast, so you are Ravenous much sooner. It is your choice to switch it on and off.
lords.drawback.greed.6: Half-Starved Mastery: time spent half-starved fills a second bar (shown in the Tensura status menu). Each level slows the hunger by 0.1, adds 1% to the stats and gives back 4% of the healing the Ravenous blade takes. Level 10 is the top.

item.anime_multiverse.black_axe_of_sloth: The Black Axe of Sloth, grown to a mountain's weight: one blow, one verdict.
The Black Axe of Sloth with its chains loosed: they drag and bind what drowses.
item.anime_multiverse.black_gunblade_of_: The Black Gunblade of Envy as a rifle: a volley aimed at everything it wants.
The Black Gunblade of Envy wound in a green serpent that coils round what it covets.
item.anime_multiverse.black_spear_of_van: The Black Spear of Vanity behind a round mirror that turns every gaze back on the gazer.
The Black Spear of Vanity fanned out like a peacock's tail, an eye on every feather.
item.anime_multiverse.seifort_holy_sword: The holy sword Seifort with its halo and winged guard: the form of judgement.
The holy sword Seifort as a sword of light, ringed by blades that fly where it is sent.
enchantment.anime_multiverse.weight_of_s: The engraving of the Black Axe of Sloth. Its arts and blows build up Weight on the wielder (slower from 50, overloaded at 100); the Mastery of Stillness eases it. Explained in the weapon's tooltip.
enchantment.anime_multiverse.hollow_of_e: The engraving of the Black Gunblade of Envy. Its arts and blows hollow the wielder out (less maximum health from 50, overloaded at 100); the Mastery of Covetousness eases it. Explained in the weapon's tooltip.
enchantment.anime_multiverse.cracked_mir: The engraving of the Black Spear of Vanity. Its arts and blows crack the mirror: the wielder glows from 50 and is weak at 100; the Mastery of Reflection eases it. Explained in the weapon's tooltip.
enchantment.anime_multiverse.penance_of_: The engraving of the holy sword Seifort. Its arts and blows build up Penance on the wielder (healing halved from 50, overloaded at 100); smiting the undead eases it, and so does the Mastery of Devotion.
enchantment.anime_multiverse.hunger_of_t: The engraving of the Black Sword Greed. The blade grows ravenous below 20 satiation (it drinks magicule and halves your healing) and sleeps at 0; it never touches your food bar. Half-Starved Mastery eases it.
anime_multiverse.skill.lord_of_slothful_: Ultimate. The skill of the Black Axe of Sloth, a Weapon of Mortal Sin. Modes: Technique (the art of the form in your hand, the right click of the axe), Manifest / Store (the axe is built out of the skill: hold it to store it back, otherwise a bound one is forged), two more techniques as modes 3 and 4 (Stillness and Crushing Gravity), the Lord's Decree as mode 5 (Abyssal Stillness, opens at level 8 of the Mastery of Stillness) and Switch form as mode 6 (the Titan's Cleaver opens at level 3, the Chained Anchor at level 6). Passive: Sinking Weight, on the plain hits of its owner's axe. Drawback: the Weight of Sloth, explained when the axe binds and in its tooltip.
anime_multiverse.skill.lord_of_green_eye: Ultimate. The skill of the Black Gunblade of Envy, a Weapon of Mortal Sin. Modes: Technique (the art of the form in your hand, the right click of the gunblade), Manifest / Store (the gunblade is built out of the skill: hold it to store it back, otherwise a bound one is forged), two more techniques as modes 3 and 4 (Green Eyes and Stolen Life), the Lord's Decree as mode 5 (Covet All, opens at level 8 of the Mastery of Covetousness) and Switch form as mode 6 (the Coveted Rifle opens at level 3, the Serpent Coil at level 6). Passive: Glaring Eyes, on the plain hits of its owner's gunblade. Drawback: the Hollow of Envy, explained when the gunblade binds and in its tooltip.
anime_multiverse.skill.lord_of_empty_van: Ultimate. The skill of the Black Spear of Vanity, a Weapon of Mortal Sin. Modes: Technique (the art of the form in your hand, the right click of the spear), Manifest / Store (the spear is built out of the skill: hold it to store it back, otherwise a bound one is forged), two more techniques as modes 3 and 4 (Reflected Thrust and Narcissus), the Lord's Decree as mode 5 (Hall of Mirrors, opens at level 8 of the Mastery of Reflection) and Switch form as mode 6 (the Mirror Glaive opens at level 3, the Peacock Halberd at level 6). Passive: Vain Shine, on the plain hits of its owner's spear. Drawback: the Cracked Mirror, explained when the spear binds and in its tooltip.
anime_multiverse.skill.seifort_holy_judg: Ultimate. The skill of the holy sword Seifort. Modes: Technique (the art of the form in your hand, the right click of the sword), Manifest / Store (the sword is built out of the skill: hold it to store it back, otherwise a bound one is forged), two more techniques as modes 3 and 4 (Purge and Holy Ground), the Lord's Decree as mode 5 (Holy Judgement, opens at level 8 of the Mastery of Devotion) and Switch form as mode 6 (Seifort, Radiant opens at level 3, Seifort, Sent Forth at level 6). Passive: Smiting Light, on the plain hits of its owner's sword. Drawback: Penance, explained when the sword binds and in its tooltip.
